verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a broad API surface covering identity onboarding, crypto and fiat transfers, fiat accounts, conversions, orders, orchestrations and event listing, so most core operations are programmatic. However, the docs describe webhook configuration, webhook testing and sandbox funding only as Dashboard actions, and nothing claims API–UI parity. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API endpoints for webhook registration and testing, API equivalents for Dashboard-only actions like sandbox Fund and credential management, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
